title: i18n(es): translate remaining untranslated Spanish locale strings
body: Resolve Spanish i18n backlog for `lang/es.json` # Description This PR completes the Spanish locale strings that still matched their English counterparts. - **503 strings translated** in `lang/es.json` using the i18n workflow (`set-translation.ts` / batch updates), preserving ICU placeholders and rich-text tags. - **37 intentionally identical strings** registered under `IGNORED.es` in `scripts/i18n/translation-stats.ts` (brand names, technical terms, and words identical in Spanish such as Legal, Total, No, Subtotal). - **1 ICU plural** (`tZEZGT`) localized to Spanish plural rules. - Locale completion updated via `npm run langs:update-progress`: **Spanish is now at 99%**. `npx tsx scripts/i18n/show-untranslated.ts es` returns no remaining items. Reviewer: @kewitz # Screenshots N/A — locale string updates only.
